title: Nocturne Atlas: a deterministic bidirectional transcoder between pre-photographic star charts and the nineteenth-century nocturne
description:
A deterministic bidirectional transcoder between pre-photographic Western star charts (Bayer 1603 to Bode 1801) and the nineteenth-century European nocturne (Field through Debussy). Implemented in pure Python with no learned model and no GPU; outputs are bit-identical given fixed input and configuration. Detected stars on a planispheric plate map to MIDI events; spectral peaks of audio map to a planisphere via time-to-angle and log-frequency-to-radius mappings. A concentric-ring artifact in audio-derived charts surfaces as a contemporary instance of the Music of the Spheres.

This software accompanies a forthcoming peer-reviewed article framing the work within the Pythagorean Quadrivium tradition.
